state.question: Has Brook Reservoir's operating change resolved the question about reservoir cover? Focus on: September usable storage in demand-days after excluding dead storage.
state.conclusion: Brook's reservoir level rose after autumn rainfall.
state.gap: September usable storage in demand-days after excluding dead storage.

candidates.title: Brook Reservoir: the measurement desk
candidates.abstract: I set out the case for Brook Reservoir's strategy in reservoir cover, using incentives and managerial judgement to project the next stage.

candidates.title: Brook Reservoir: the operating record
candidates.abstract: Our reporting desk follows Brook Reservoir, drawing on an independent correspondent's account of september usable storage in demand-days after excluding dead storage.

candidates.title: Brook Reservoir: the latest field dispatch
candidates.abstract: An edited digest of Noah Costa's Dispatch's dispatch on Brook Reservoir, retaining its reported comparison and attribution.

candidates.title: Brook Reservoir: what the announcement changes
candidates.abstract: An operating note about Brook Reservoir: Total reservoir storage was 18 million cubic metres.

candidates.title: Brook Reservoir: the weekly notebook
candidates.abstract: A commentary revisiting Brook Reservoir's operating announcement, carrying the same factual account as the public record.

candidates.title: Brook Reservoir: the strategic argument
candidates.abstract: Brook reservoir level survey supports a dated assessment of september usable storage in demand-days after excluding dead storage.
